text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Mejiro Dober and I are on our way to watch the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yeah, I'm fine… It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clearly, it's not nothing… Something's been on her mind since the Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm hoping that watching Mejiro Bright race today will lift her spirits, but…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The race is about to start, and Bright still isn't here…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Do you think she's okay? She's always so easygoing… Do you think she might still be—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We suddenly hear the sound of footsteps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The sound stops, and we see a stern Mejiro Bright before us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Oh… Bright. Um…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Without acknowledging us, Mejiro Bright walks away.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober stares at her retreating form, unable to call out to her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright… She didn't even see me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: She only has eyes for the race!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And then…

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Bright is in the lead! She's staying strong and still ahead of the pack!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Aaand Bright has taken the win! The Mejiro family has won the spring Tenno Sho! Congratulations to Mejiro Bright!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Bright! Bright! Bright! Bright! Bright! Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: …I finally did it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: My name is Mejiro Bright. Today, I have conquered Yodo…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And won the Mejiro family a new plaque!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: The seasons have changed… And in this new era of Mejiros, I, Mejiro Bright, have burst into full bloom!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Wow…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright, you're amazing!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Goodness! Dober, you're here! And so is your trainer! I didn't even realize you'd come all this way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, Bright! You ran so well out there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You won the spring plaque… I can't believe you won it for the Mejiro family, just like McQueen did!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You're just fantastic! With this, I'm sure your legacy is as good as secured!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Indeed! With this…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: We can finally begin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: After experiencing loss after loss during my classic year, I have finally managed to blossom in this new spring.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: I have now achieved something that the Mejiros who walked before us can be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: But this is just the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: We must surpass the victories that previous Mejiro racers like McQueen and Ryan claimed before us…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: And forge our own glorious legacies, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Bright…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (She's incredible… Even after such an impressive accomplishment, she's already thinking of her next goal.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (Bright seems like a different person. She feels strong and dignified, just like… Yeah. She's just like Air Groove.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You're so incredible, Bright. What do I have to do in order to be like y—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober. As you are right now, the future and glory you crave are far beyond your reach.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Because those are things that only one person in the world can ever claim.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And that person is Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? When…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: When did I start wanting to become someone else?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: When did I decide that it was enough to claim the same achievements as someone else?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober doesn't say a word on our way back from the Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's only after we arrive at my office that she begins to speak.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I finally understand now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I understand what you were trying to say after the Osaka Hai, and what Air Groove meant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I understand what you were trying to say after the Osaka Hai, and what Air Groove meant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I know why I can't become like Air Groove, Bright, or another Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can't become someone else. I have to be me… right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I want to continue the legacy Ramonu left behind…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: The reason I decided to race in the Triple Tiara was because I wanted to be like Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: If I walk the path she walked and reach the heights she reached… Maybe if I become like her…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And the reason I picked this race schedule for my senior year was because I wanted to be like Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Even today, I was thinking about how great it would be to be like Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I'm not like them…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: McQueen, Ryan, Bright, Air Groove, and everyone else…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: They run with their own strength on their own path in their own way! They're determined to make themselves shine! That's what makes them strong.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I don't have that confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I don't have the resolve to make myself shine! So I just followed them, hoping to pick up scraps of their light along the way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But doing that won't work. I can't forge a new Mejiro legacy that way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Not while I'm so weak!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I appreciate the fact that you always reassure me. Really, I do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I appreciate the fact that you always reassure me. Really, I do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I want to confront my problems head-on. I need to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I can't keep ignoring the bad stuff. I have to admit that I'm a sneaky weakling.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But still… You believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But still… You believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You believe that I can overcome my weakness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: You have faith that I'm strong enough to do that… right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I knew you'd say that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run in the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But I'm not doing it because I want to chase after Air Groove or because I want to be like someone else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm going to run in it so I can conquer my weakness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'm running in it so I can become truly strong.
